decisions.statement: The operator is found in the parse and never in the text.
The operator is refused wherever an expression may sit.
An operator reached through an optional chain is refused as a bare operator is.
An operator sitting on another operator is refused once for each operator.
A definite assignment written on a declaration is another spelling and is not this operator.
Logical negation shares the character and is untouched.

definition: the rule refusing a value called present with `!` where the types say it may be absent
